title: Workflows
description: Turn project milestones, client decisions and monthly consumption into the next action.
forbidden: Only organization owners and managers can configure their workflows.
name: Name
createNote: Saved paused. Simulate before enabling. Up to 20 rules per person and 100 per organization; rule content cannot be edited after saving.
timing: Runs approximately every minute. Only events after enabling are processed; paused events are not replayed. Rules use current permissions and conditions. Actions do not trigger further workflow chains.
error: Could not complete this action. Check the values, limits and your access, then retry.
simulation: Simulation: {{matches}} ready among {{sampled}} accessible events (up to 100 historical events). No actions or messages were created.
historyNote: Latest 50 evaluations. Each event runs once per rule; safe retries remain in the same record, with up to 5 attempts.
searchOptions: Find a person or project (up to 50 results)
recipientNote: Access and membership are checked again when the rule runs. External channels also require the recipient’s preferences and an available connection.
projectNote: The project must belong to the client in the event. Other clients’ events are skipped.
billingNote: Uses the approved amount and currency, reusing any existing commercial draft. Monthly fees remain with the contract. Review and issue the invoice separately; this action never sends or charges it.
assignmentNote: Replaces the current project assignee. The selected person gains access to that project.
source_changed: The source changed or is no longer eligible
recipient_unavailable: Recipient is no longer an active member
channel_unavailable: Channel not configured or no browser subscribed
failed: Action failed; no resource was created
uncertainNote: Check delivery with the provider before sending anything manually. Automatic resend is disabled to avoid duplicates.
